notes.zh-CN: 输入框支持 / 斜杠命令：输入 / 会列出当前 CLI 为这个会话上报的命令（Codex 的 /compact、CodeBuddy 的自定义命令等），可继续输入筛选，方向键选择，Enter 或 Tab 补全，Esc 关闭，鼠标点击同样可用。补全只填入命令和空格，发送仍由你自己确认。
notes.en: Slash commands in the composer: typing / lists the commands the current CLI reports for the session (Codex's /compact, CodeBuddy custom commands, and so on). Keep typing to filter, use the arrow keys to move, Enter or Tab to complete, Esc to close, or click a row. Picking a command only fills the box in; sending stays a separate Enter.
